conditions: A build selecting a language version with -cl-std on the named API paths, with support for OpenCL C 1.2 or newer as stated.
limitations: The omitted-option case is separate. OpenCL API version constants and the versions a device advertises are different from the version selected for this compilation.

triggers: Publisher correction, applicable new edition, changed exact representation or contrary evidence.

statement: The v3.0.19 OpenCL C specification defines __OPENCL_C_VERSION__ to reflect the language version selected using the -cl-std option to clBuildProgram or clCompileProgram.
